business_summary: Oakridge Health Networks operates twelve regional hospitals, forty-three outpatient clinics, and six diagnostic laboratories across the Midwest. The organization specializes in oncology, cardiology, trauma care, and rural healthcare services. The company has aggressively expanded through acquisitions over the past six years, integrating multiple hospital systems into one organization.
recent_news: Received a $150,000 HIPAA fine after investigators found patient information transmitted over unsecured fax lines.
CEO announced a three-year digital transformation initiative focused on interoperability and patient experience.
Opened two new specialty hospitals following the acquisition of MidWest Care Group.
Hired a new Chief Digital Officer from a Fortune 100 healthcare company.
Expanded telemedicine services into four additional states.
recent_events: Migrating selected workloads to Microsoft Azure.
